# InputLabel

```ts
import { InputLabel } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The label row that sits above a form field — a reusable form element, not a standalone page heading. TextInput composes it, and future fields (Textarea, Select, …) should too; only reach for it directly when building a new field component.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The label text. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Type size: md 16px (standalone rows), sm 14px (inside form fields — TextInput uses this). |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Appends the "(required)" suffix, right-aligned after the text. |
| `showInfo` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a 16px info icon after the text (inherits the label color). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Dims the label text + icon (the "(required)" suffix keeps its color). |
| `htmlFor` | `string` | — | The form control this label describes. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.LabelHTMLAttributes<HTMLLabelElement>, 'children'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<InputLabel htmlFor="email">Email</InputLabel>
<InputLabel htmlFor="email" required>Email</InputLabel>
<InputLabel htmlFor="email" showInfo>Email</InputLabel>
<InputLabel htmlFor="email" size="sm">Email</InputLabel>   // inside fields
<InputLabel htmlFor="email" disabled>Email</InputLabel>
```

## Design tokens used

`--font-weight-medium`, `--color-text-icon-primary`, `--type-size-subject`, `--type-size-body`, `--font-weight-regular`, `--type-size-helper`, `--color-text-icon-placeholder`, `--color-disabled-disabled-inverse`, `--space-050`, `--space-100`

## Accessibility

- Renders a native <label> — always pass htmlFor so clicking it focuses the field and assistive tech links the two.
- Radix Label prevents text selection on double-click (a native label annoyance), nothing else — the semantics are the platform's.
- The info icon is aria-hidden decoration; put the actual guidance in the field's helper string, not in the icon alone.
- "(required)" is visible text (not just an asterisk), so it's announced as-is.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Compose it inside field components, wired via htmlFor. | Use it as a general text style — it's a form label. |
| Use size="sm" inside fields (TextInput does). | Mix label sizes within one form. |
| Mark required fields with required. | Add your own asterisk conventions. |
